summary.poolingMethod: Sum of the work counters divided by sum of measured elapsed seconds; profile runs excluded.
summary.interpretation: A 14.8% measured collection-rate improvement over the already-hanchan baseline. The CFR/Nano ratio compares different work counters, policies, retained seats and persistence guarantees; it is not a matched-work efficiency ratio.

specificationChange.trajectoryDefinition: One completed main-game hand in HAND_GRP; each hand resets local importance products. Fixed GRP supplies nonterminal hand-boundary utility; terminal hanchan uses realized rank utility.
specificationChange.normalization: N is the actual total persisted LCFR trajectories in the iteration, not the number of hanchan. One complete hanchan file contains its hand trajectories.
specificationChange.rootDistribution: Later hand roots follow the current rollout policy through the hanchan. This is a collection-distribution change from the former generated hand-root workload and may affect learning quality.
specificationChange.separation: The 14.8% benchmark improvement compares two already-hanchan versions and does not attribute the hand-to-hanchan specification change or learner microbatch changes to direct-bucket speedup.
specificationChange.persistence: Per-hand compressed append with a bounded four-worker/sixteen-pending writer; one fsync and atomic publish per completed hanchan. Partial files do not count as completed matches.

comparisonLimits: CFR preserves all four seats; Nano retains one rotating actor seat. CFR main decisions include forced choices and exclude branch counts; Nano network requests include all evaluated seats and branches, with forced opponent requests skipped.
Different checkpoints/policies and exploration produce different hand/decision counts. Same seed integer does not imply matched walls across model series.
Nano actor evaluation includes value and policy; opponents use policy only. Branch configuration and frozen GRP are shared, but branch opportunities/termination differ.
Both include persistence drain. Nano production persistence has no fsync; CFR completed-match publication includes fsync.
Two repetitions of one seed are evidence of repeatability for this workload, not multi-seed confidence intervals or long-term strength.
GPU0 device-wide VRAM/RSS sampling spans setup, warmup, collection and post-run diagnostics; initial VRAM differs. It is not framework allocated/reserved memory.
Full production iterations at 32768 hanchan, long-term training quality and production-run restart were not performed.

comparison.limitations: JFR sampling is statistical, not CPU/GPU time. Allocation weights estimate Java heap allocated bytes, not retained heap. Warmup/setup/post-run decode excluded. Profile run rates are separate from unprofiled benchmark rates. Timestamp clipping uses microsecond-resolution datetime.

baseline.windowScope: Last complete group of four cfr-episode-writer threads, from first ThreadStart to last ThreadEnd. This approximates the measured collection interval within thread startup and join/report bookkeeping; it excludes subsequent observation decoding. Compare against the measured seconds from THIS profiled run, not an unprofiled run.
baseline.limitations: ExecutionSample and NativeMethodSample counts are separate statistical samples, not CPU seconds or GPU kernel time. Native samples may include JNI/event polling or blocking calls. ObjectAllocationSample.weight estimates allocated Java-heap bytes; it is not exact object size, live/retained heap, RSS, direct memory or device allocation. Inclusive frame counts overlap. Allocation sampled weights can straddle the selected window. Duration events are clipped to the window and summed across threads; summed durations can exceed wall time. File events include only configured threshold hits.

import os,sys,json,time,pathlib,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
kind,tag=sys.argv[1:3]
assert kind in ('nano','cfr') and tag.replace('-','').isalnum()
output=root/tag
assert not output.exists()
java='/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64/bin/java'
jni='/home/koutachan/.m2/repository/ai/djl/pytorch/pytorch-jni-rocm7.2-linux-x86_64/2.11.0-0.40.4-rocm7.2.2-cfr-SNAPSHOT/pytorch-jni-rocm7.2-linux-x86_64-2.11.0-0.40.4-rocm7.2.2-cfr-SNAPSHOT.jar'
board=root.parent/'cfr-event-optimization-20261009'
grp='/home/koutachan/epsilon-ai/runs/epsilon-cfr-lcfr-nano-20261008/train-32768-bounded/artifacts/nano-source-00000000-4cee842e-8409-40e3-818c-39f494e96720'
env=os.environ.copy();env.update(HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES='0',PYTORCH_FLAVOR='rocm7.2',PYTORCH_VERSION='2.11.0',OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1')
if kind=='nano':
 cmd=['bash',str(root/'run-nano-collection.sh'),str(root/'hanchan.jar'),str(output),'4096','256','20261008']
else:
 cmd=[java,'-Xms1g','-Xmx20g','-XX:MaxDirectMemorySize=6g','-Dai.djl.pytorch.num_threads=1','-Dai.djl.pytorch.num_interop_threads=1','-cp',str(root/'cfr-tests')+':'+jni+':'+str(root/'hanchan.jar'),'com.epsilon.cfr.benchmark.CfrPerformanceBenchmark','collect',str(root/'cfr-collection.toml'),str(board/'optimized-input'),grp,str(output),'256','true']
resource=pathlib.Path('/sys/class/drm/card0/device/mem_info_vram_used')
initial=int(resource.read_text());peak=initial;peak_rss=0;samples=0;started=time.monotonic()
with (root/(tag+'.log')).open('wb') as log:
 p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 (root/(tag+'.pid')).write_text(str(p.pid))
 while p.poll() is None:
  peak=max(peak,int(resource.read_text()));samples+=1
  try:
   for line in pathlib.Path('/proc/'+str(p.pid)+'/status').read_text().splitlines():
    if line.startswith('VmRSS:'): peak_rss=max(peak_rss,int(line.split()[1])*1024)
  except FileNotFoundError: pass
  time.sleep(.05)
 code=p.returncode
report={'exitCode':code,'command':cmd,'processSeconds':time.monotonic()-started,'initialDeviceBytes':initial,'peakDeviceBytes':peak,'peakProcessRssBytes':peak_rss,'sampleCount':samples,'memoryScope':'GPU0 device-wide VRAM and Java process RSS sampled every 50 ms over the entire process, including setup, warmup and diagnostics; not framework allocator metrics.','gpuMemorySource':str(resource)}
(root/(tag+'-resources.json')).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
(root/(tag+'.exit')).write_text(str(code)+'\n')
print(tag,code,round(report['processSeconds'],3),flush=True)
sys.exit(code)

# Epsilon-CFR の同梱既定設定。同梱値 < 選択したTOML < 明示上書きの順に適用する。
# 系列CLIの --settings / -Depsilon.* は他系列と共通。省略項目は同梱値を使う。
# run/config.json は確定値の保存形式であり、再開中は変更しない。

[epsilon.cfr]
seed = 20261007
solves = 1
iterations = 128
# commonの順位効用。TENHOU / PLACEMENT / TOP / LAST_AVOIDANCE / MLEAGUE。
# 終端・GRP境界・分岐・昇格評価を同じ尺度にする。run開始後は変更しない。
utilityProfile = "TENHOU"

[epsilon.cfr.collection]
# 両方式とも半荘を最後まで収集する。HAND_GRPは局ごとに固定GRPで評価し、MATCH_MCは最終順位を使う。
mode = "HAND_GRP"
games = 32768
# 同時に進める半荘数。HAND_GRPでは保存先に受け渡した局の観測を順次解放する。
concurrentGames = 4096
inferenceBatch = 4096
multiTransitionMaxBatch = 2048
slotsPerDevice = 2
readyBatchesPerDevice = 4
exploration = 0.10
centerUtility = true

[epsilon.cfr.collection.arena]
advanceWorkers = 32
advanceTasksPerWorker = 2
maximumAdvanceTaskSize = 64

[epsilon.cfr.collection.batching]
maxBatchWaitMicros = 1000000

[epsilon.cfr.collection.branchComparison]
# RON見逃しと九種九牌の二択を追加枝で比較する。通常の収集数や平均方策の教師には含めない。
enabled = true
winDecline = true
kyushu = true
maxBranchesPerGame = 1
maxInFlightBranches = 8
# 追加枝の開始予算。開始済みの枝は同じ評価境界まで進めるため、完了時には超える場合がある。
maxExtraInferenceRatio = 0.01

[epsilon.cfr.learning]
# 1更新でreplayから抽選する判断数。collection.gamesの収集半荘数とは別。
batchSize = 1024
# 1デバイスの計算上限。複数GPUではbatchSizeをデバイス数で分けた上限も適用する。
microBatchSize = 1024
regretUpdates = 256
# evaluation.everyで指定した評価直前と、各solveの最終反復だけ学習する。
averageUpdates = 256
checkpointEveryUpdates = 32
learningRate = 2e-4
weightDecay = 1e-4
gradientClip = 0.5
computePrecision = "BFLOAT16"
tensorTransfer = "PINNED_BUFFER"

[epsilon.cfr.replay]
regretCapacity = 1048576
averageCapacity = 1048576
# 圧縮payload保存量の上限128GiB、1判断の上限1MiB。
maxStoredBytes = 137438953472
maxRowBytes = 1048576
cacheRows = 1024

[epsilon.cfr.network]
# Nano初期化では元checkpointのhiddenと揃える。
hidden = 256

[epsilon.cfr.network.devices]
# 空文字列は利用可能な全GPU、自動選択できなければCPU。明示GPU指定はCPUへfallbackしない。
validateIndices = false
learner = ""
inference = ""
grp = "cpu"

[epsilon.cfr.boundary]
# 空文字列は未指定。相対パスは起動ディレクトリ基準。
checkpoint = ""
bootstrapGames = 4096
calibrationGames = 4096

[epsilon.cfr.evaluation]
# 平均方策の学習と評価の共通間隔。平均用の教師は毎反復蓄積する。
every = 10

[epsilon.cfr.evaluation.championDuel]
interimWallSeeds = 50000
maximumWallSeeds = 100000
alpha = 0.01
interimAlphaFraction = 0.25

[epsilon.cfr.evaluation.evalVs]
gamesInFlight = 32768
maximumInferenceBatch = 2048
progressIntervalWallSeeds = 2048
seedBase = 40000

[epsilon.cfr.evaluation.arena]
advanceWorkers = 32
advanceTasksPerWorker = 2
maximumAdvanceTaskSize = 64

[epsilon.cfr.evaluation.batching]
maxBatchWaitMicros = 1000000

[epsilon.cfr.initialization]
# 空ならNano初期化を行わない。指定時はrunへ元モデルを固定保存する。
nanoCheckpoint = ""
games = 256
updates = 2048
capacity = 65536
